description: Per-character lists of decal actor Blueprint asset names, used when preloading battle assets for characters that project decals.

ID.simple: Row key, normally the character ID referenced by Character::Id_CharacterDecal.
ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export). BattleAssets_CharacterDecals_12BC3C0 resolves Character::Id_CharacterDecal against CharacterDecalDataTables (DTM +0x500); a None value skips the lookup entirely. Only 11 of the exported characters have a non-None reference.

FileName_BP.simple: Array of decal Blueprint asset names to preload.
FileName_BP.technical: TArray<FName>, row +0x10, values such as DCL_00300_BP. BattleAssets_CharacterDecals_12BC3C0 appends the whole array (including any None entries) to the battle-preload asset-name output; the collector is shared by battle prepare (GamePhase_BattleBase state 1) and battle preload. Missing rows contribute nothing. No direct spawn-time reader of this field was found in the reconstructed source: the observed use is asset collection/preload only.

notes: Export contains 11 rows, each with five FileName_BP slots; unused slots are None.
The only identifiable field consumer in the reconstructed source is the shared battle asset collector; the limit is documented rather than extended to unproven gameplay uses.
Single table asset 'CharacterDecalDataTable' loaded into DTM +0x500; no numbered shards or localized variants in the export.
Reconstructed C++ with retail RVA comments; no claim about Blueprint-only consumers or byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Skips characters with no CharacterDecal ID.
Resolves the row and appends FileName_BP to the battle preload list.
